code:
Dependency View =
  visual graph of existing cmdb_rel_ci records

Not a separate dataset. Not a calculation.
Missing or wrong relationships show up missing or wrong.
caption: It shows exactly what's already stored — nothing more.

eyebrow: Two ways to build the graph

steps.label: Manual documentation
steps.sub: a person records each cmdb_rel_ci — simple, but needs ongoing upkeep

steps.label: Service Mapping
steps.sub: traces real network/process connections to discover relationships automatically

steps.label: Most real instances
steps.sub: use both, split by which services are worth the automation

code:
Entry point: load balancer / web server
    |
    v  (traces real traffic)
Application tier  --connected to-->  Database tier

Builds cmdb_rel_ci records from what it finds running --
not from what a person remembered to type in.
caption: Discovery of relationships, not just discovery of CIs.

code:
Manual:            cheap to start, decays as the environment grows
Service Mapping:    stays current, but needs credentials,
                     configuration, and typically its own license
caption: Neither approach is simply "better" — they trade off differently.
